note: Since Qv=v has only v=0, ker(I-Q)={0}; finite-dimensional square linear algebra gives invertibility. Set w=(I-Q)^{-1}u. Then Qw=w-u. Orthogonality gives ||w-u||^2=||Qw||^2=||w||^2, so u^T w=1/2 because ||u||=1. Therefore HQw=(I-2uu^T)(w-u)=w-u-2u(u^T w-1)=w. Also w is nonzero because (I-Q)w=u and u has norm one.
